evidence.title: Zapier: Automate AI Workflows, Agents, and Apps

name: Zapier
summary: No-code automation platform connecting 9,000+ apps to build workflows, AI agents and chatbots.
description: Zapier connects thousands of apps and AI tools so teams can run automations and AI-assisted work: workflows (Zaps), AI Agents, chatbots, Tables, Forms and MCP-connected assistants. Documentation, a TypeScript SDK and CLI, and thousands of templates serve developers and non-technical builders alike; free and paid plans scale with usage.
contains: workflows (Zaps), AI Agents, chatbots, Tables, Forms and an MCP server
TypeScript SDK, CLI and open-source repos (github.com/zapier/sdk)
free plan plus Professional, Team and Enterprise tiers
template library by use case, app and role
81 billion tasks automated; 69% of the Fortune 1000 use Zapier
